# Requirements-Quality Checklist: Senior Manager Cost Sheet Review (Feature 007)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality gate for the Feature 007 spec/plan/contract package — validates that the requirements themselves are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and testable before task generation. It does **not** test implementation.
**Created**: 2026-11-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [contracts/senior-review-api.md](../contracts/senior-review-api.md) | [001 spec](../..//001-pettycash-v1-core/spec.md#FR-037)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Reuses existing active-`SENIOR_MANAGER` semantics and contract-defined `404`/`UnsupportedSelection` errors; no new permission or widened scope.
- [ ] CHK003 Is the combined XLSX export column shape (sheet id/title/currency/submitted total; transaction id/description/expense type/amount/date; **separate** Cost Center and Senior decision fields; status) enumerated at the requirement level rather than deferred to the plan/contract only? [Completeness, Clarity, FR-007-043; Plan §Reporting; contracts §2]

- [ ] CHK005 Is D8 (derive Senior sheet rows only from a proven-complete set; never a partial flat fallback table) expressed as a requirement (FR-007-016), not only as a plan-level design rule or edge case? [Completeness, FR-007-016; Plan §D5c]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "final Cost Center decision" defined with the **same** enumeration in the requirement (FR-007-013), plan D1, the contract note, and the 001 FR-037 amendment (Approve/Reject final; a Return corrected then re-decided final; a pending Return **not** final)? [Clarity, Consistency, FR-007-013; Plan §D1; contracts §1; 001 FR-037]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the XLSX-only rule unambiguous — a non-`xlsx` request for the `senior-queue` resource is refused, and existing CSV/PDF capabilities for other resources are untouched (D3)? [Clarity, FR-007-043/044; Plan §Reporting]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "on-screen order" for the export defined precisely at requirement level (the modal's filtered + sorted list, stable secondary tiebreak by transaction id), not left to implementation? [Clarity, FR-007-042/043; Plan §Sorting Model; contracts §3]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the `allTransactionsCostCenterDecided` value semantics specified, including the `null` (gate capability not yet provable → sheet not shown, never labelled "waiting") case? [Clarity, FR-007-013; Spec §Key Entities; Plan data model; contracts §1]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the one-currency amount-filter semantics unambiguous (disabled until exactly one currency selected, bounds always read as the selected currency's minor units and re-stated on change, no conversion)? [Clarity, FR-007-018; Plan §Filtering Model (D6)]
- [ ] CHK012 Is `reviewStatus` / "Review Completed" explicitly separated from the domain `SheetStatus` derivation (presentation projection, not a persisted entity) so implementers cannot conflate them? [Clarity, FR-007-017; Spec §Key Entities; Plan §D5b]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality & Testability

- [ ] CHK020 Is the sheet-entry gate (D1) testable: an acceptance scenario proves (a) a pending/returned-for-correction transaction excludes the sheet, and (b) a rejected transaction does not by itself keep or remove a gate-satisfying sheet? [Measurability, US1 AC 2/3; SC-007-007]
- [ ] CHK021 Can SC-007-002/003 ("100% of amounts/counts/statuses traceable; no invented value in any tested state") be objectively checked across loading/empty/error/truncation states? [Measurability, SC-007-002/003; FR-007-011/012]
- [ ] CHK022 Is exported-selection equality (exactly the filtered + sorted rows, in on-screen order, separate CC/Senior fields) a verifiable criterion, including an explicit backend test assertion that row order equals the submitted `ids` order (D4)? [Measurability, FR-007-043; Plan §Testing/§Reporting; contracts §3]
- [ ] CHK023 Is single-decision exactness and FR-085 first-write-wins covered by an acceptance criterion at requirement level (exactly one transaction decision per action; no fabricated local status on refusal/supersede)? [Coverage, US2 AC 1/4; FR-007-021; 001 FR-085]
- [ ] CHK024 Are acceptance scenarios traceable to specific `FR-007-xxx` requirements (explicit IDs/links), rather than prose bullets with no link to the requirement set? [Traceability, Spec §User Scenarios vs §Requirements]
- [ ] CHK025 Is D9 testable: acceptance criteria prove the modal opens over the mounted queue with **no route navigation** and closes with focus restored to the originating sheet row? [Measurability, US1 AC 7; US2 AC 5; FR-007-002/009]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the export refusal path (missing Senior capability → refusal naming the capability; never an empty artifact presented as measured; measured-zero only for a legitimate empty selection) stated as a testable acceptance criterion? [Measurability, US4 AC 5; FR-007-044]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Are alternative flows specified for a sheet whose transactions span multiple cost centers with the manager assigned to only some — is the partial-scope rendering requirement defined and tested, or only noted once in Edge Cases? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases; §Key Entities scope; Plan §D1]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the exception flow specified for a sheet that disappears between queue load and modal open (another manager decided the last pending transaction) — honest refreshed state, no synthesized "empty"? [Coverage, Exception, Spec §Edge Cases; Plan §Modal Open/Close Contract]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the recovery path specified for network failure mid-submit (retry, FR-084 replay safety, no fabricated state), at both requirement and scenario level? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases; Plan §Senior Decision Flow; 001 FR-084]
- [ ] CHK030 Are empty/zero states specified at both levels — no gate-satisfying sheets, and a legitimate empty filtered selection producing a header-only measured-zero XLSX rather than a refusal? [Coverage, US1 AC 6; US4 AC 5; FR-007-044]
